# Lavendar Lewis

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-forties  <sub>[v2 c21 P11](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0011), [v2 c21 P13](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0013), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P13](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c5 P2](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v2 c21 P13](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0013)</sub>; Mrs.  <sub>[v4 c5 P2](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mother Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c23 P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002), [v4 c23 P3](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Lavendar Lewis is a small, dainty woman with a girlish, pink-cheeked face, wood-brown eyes with golden glints, and thick, snow-white hair worn in soft, waving coils and puffs over her ears. She possesses an expressive face, dimples, and a youthful, pretty appearance that defies her age. She delights in wearing feminine, frilly gowns, such as frilled cream muslin or forget-me-not organdy, often accented with pale-hued roses or a silvery gray silk shawl.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P13](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0013), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c23 P5](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0005), [v2 c23 P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P19](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0019), [v2 c30 P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003)_

## Personality

Lavendar is a sweet, imaginative, and romantic woman who retains a youthful spirit and a playful love of 'pretending.' She possesses a vivid imagination, a gentle sense of humor, and an affectionate, hospitable nature that warmly embraces kindred spirits. Though generally cheerful and charming, she admits to an occasional streak of sulkiness and pride when hurt or provoked. She is deeply sensitive to beauty and love, cherishing dreams, poetry, and nature.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P13](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0013), [v2 c21 P15](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0015), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c21 P89](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0089), [v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c23 P12](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0012), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c27 P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031)_

- Imaginative and romantic  <sub>[v2 c21 P15](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0015), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)</sub>
- Youthful at heart  <sub>[v2 c22 P6](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0006), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009)</sub>

## Abilities

- Creating a warm, imaginative, and artistic home environment  <sub>[v2 c21 P42](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0042), [v4 c6 P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 c7 P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004)</sub>
- Cooking delicious pastries, cake, and shortbread  <sub>[v2 c21 P9](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0009), [v2 c21 P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 c23 P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep her heart young and surround herself with beauty, affection, and kindred spirits  <sub>[v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c23 P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 c27 P32](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0032)</sub>
- To reunite with her early love, Stephen Irving, and build a happy life together  <sub>[v2 c28 P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030), [v2 c28 P39](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0039)</sub>

## History

Lavendar Lewis grew up at Echo Lodge, a secluded stone house in Grafton. In her youth, she was engaged to Stephen Irving, but after a petty quarrel, her pride and sulkiness prevented a reconciliation, leading Stephen to move away to the United States. Following the deaths of her parents, Lavendar remained at Echo Lodge for decades, living a quiet, dream-filled life in near isolation, assisted by a series of young girls whom she called Charlotta. When Anne Shirley and Diana Barry accidentally stumbled upon her home, Lavendar welcomed them warmly, finding in Anne a true kindred spirit. Through Anne, Lavendar met Stephen's son, Paul Irving, with whom she instantly formed a deep, maternal bond. Upon learning of her whereabouts from Paul, Stephen Irving returned to Prince Edward Island to seek out Lavendar. The two reconciled, rekindling their old affection, and were married in the garden at Echo Lodge in the late summer. Following their wedding, they embarked on a trip to the Pacific coast and subsequently settled in Boston, returning to spend their summers at Echo Lodge.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c23 P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019), [v2 c23 P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 c28 P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022), [v2 c28 P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030), [v2 c28 P33](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0033), [v2 c28 P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 c28 P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 c29 P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Named Lavendar by her father because he loved the scent associated with his courtship of her mother  <sub>[v2 c21 P86](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0086)</sub>
- Was engaged in her youth to Stephen Irving, but broke it off after a foolish quarrel and her own stubborn pride  <sub>[v2 c22 P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 c23 P16](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0016), [v2 c23 P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)</sub>
- Lived for many years in the secluded stone house, Echo Lodge, in Grafton  <sub>[v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v2 c21 P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028)</sub>
- Employed a succession of young girls named Charlotta to assist her with housework  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> What is the use of being an independent old maid if you can't be silly when you want to, and when it doesn't hurt anybody?  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054)</sub>

> Some are born old maids, some achieve old maidenhood, and some have old maidenhood thrust upon them.  <sub>[v2 c23 P13](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0013)</sub>

> I felt dreadful when John and I quarrelled, but underneath it all I was very happy because I had such a nice husband to quarrel with and make it up with.  <sub>[v2 c27 P48](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0048)</sub>

> A person must have some compensations. I don't believe I could live at times if I didn't pretend things.  <sub>[v2 c21 P54](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0054)</sub>

> I can't reconcile myself to it as most women seem to. I'm just as rebellious as I was when I discovered my first gray hair.  <sub>[v2 c23 P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010)</sub>
